Can perform Stick, DC TIG, Pulsed DC TIG, MIG, Pulsed MIG, Flux-Cored processes. Provides an extremely fast arc response, includes over 65 standard welding waveforms for optimized performance.	Exceptional welding performance with high power factor and efficiency for welding thicker materials
